data.long_meaning: In Persian, Parinaz means 'light' or 'bright'. This name evokes images of radiance and illumination, symbolizing hope, optimism, and the triumph of light over darkness. The name Parinaz carries the meaning “Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Parinaz usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The Prophet Muhammad said, "Allah's Messenger said, "O Allah, our Lord! Send upon us (some) Light from Yourself." (Bukhari 3507). The name Parinaz can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual light that guides individuals on their spiritual journey. Moreover, the name can be understood as a reflection of the light within, representing the inner light of the soul that continues to shine regardless of external circumstances. Together, the cultural and spiritual significance of the name Parinaz serves to inspire hope, optimism, and a reminder of the light that both illuminates the world and resides within us.
